[nation]Nederlandse staat[/nation]][i]Nederlandses attempted assaults on Daesunite coastal towns and merchant ships proved ineffective. Their warships, built with primitive designs and armed with outdated naval guns, were no match for Daesuns modern missile-guided destroyers. The ragtag fleet was quickly overwhelmed, but Pantagruel had no intention of stopping at simply sinking ships.

Daesuns navy primarily employed inexpensive anti-ship missiles calibrated to strike the center bow of these alleged pirate vessels. This minimized casualties and preserved the ships structure for intelligence analysis. Once each vessel was disabled, a gunboat squadron was dispatched to recover survivors. They were then transported to Daesun and held for trial.

Daesun was not interested in killing these men. Instead, every prisoner underwent an extensive background investigation involving birthplace, origin, education, and other key details. Each factor helped trace where these individuals came from. A pattern slowly emerged as Daesunite intelligence continued to dig forward. Nearly all the conspirators shared a common origin in Nederlandse.

Further abnormalities appeared in the ships manifests, including equipment accessible only to the Dutch military, irregular fuel and cargo records, operations occurring dangerously close to or even inside the BalionDaesun warzone, and docking logs in Hyunseo followed by immediate departures toward Daesunite coastal towns.

With sufficient evidence and a clear justification, Daesun formally accuses the Dutch state of sponsoring terrorist activity by aiding mercenaries in unlawful attacks on Daesunite civilians and merchant vessels, filing the case with the ICJ.

The Dutch States attempt to indirectly attack Daesun was now recognized as a direct attack, and therefore a formal violation of the nations sovereignty meaning that Daesun now had the ability to invoke existing mutual defence pacts with other nations. The states of Oceanice Republic, Neue Republik, Immeria, Hayan Dal, Hyunseo, Luscaria, Avalon, and Valddera are all required under their active mutual defence pacts to aid Daesun. Preparations for an international coalition for the invasion of the Dutch State are underway once permitted by the ICJ. 

Until then, the Mugungwha Shield was deployed to southwestern Vespuria while KF-21s were swiftly dispatched to do aerial patrol operations within proximity of the Dutch States airspace. [/i][/spoiler]

[spoiler=[nation]British Calradia[/nation]]
[i]The Balionic airforce underestimated the ability of the Daesunite F-35Cs , with its F135 turbofan engines the Panthers were able to quickly rise in elevation, far surpassing the range of the Balionic drones and resuming military operation. From under their weapons bays they launched JSMs, continuing the relentless bombardment of Balionic AD Destroyers.

With complete dominance in the communication field, Daesun had forced Balion to utilize an older more traditional form of communication that would prove largely inefficient due to its time consuming and easily interceptable manner. With this advantage, EA-18s continued to smother Balionic ships with noise jamming, disorienting radars and making it almost impossible for Balionic radar crews to even spot the signature of what was to come.

While the PAF and PSCF continued to make significant contributions to the war effort, the progress of the PNF remained quite slow. But this was not due to hindrance, but planning. Changho-class SSGNs submerged deep within the oceans thermal layers had now received permission to strike targets on Empire Island. From atop their hulls theyd release their Cheonyang cruise missiles, thanks to synchronized VLS systems, the SSGNs didnt need to surface to release their armaments and therefore could instantaneously return to stealth operations after the attack. 

Over 32 cruise missiles streaked towards their targets, each guided precisely by powerful GPS-III and inertial signals granting them the ability to strike with surgical precision. As Balionic air defences scrambled to try and intercept the horde of cruise missiles, theyd have to come to terms with the Cheonyangs sea-skimming ability and relatively small radar-cross section which made possible detection and interception virtually impossible due to prior Growler jamming efforts. 

Balions foolish decision to utilize underwater drones also proved to be a major mistake, as P-8s, subs, and Mh-60rs easily picked up the sound waves of their propellers with their active sonars, allowing for them to move their buoys and buy time for ASW rockets to detect, find, and destroy their targets. But this was not the only blunder Balion made, Virginia-class SSNs already listening in on sea-displacement were able to easily track and mark the locations of where the drones were activated, guiding their active torpedoes towards these targets with a heightened proximity fuze to ensure a certain strike.

F-35Cs over the flashpoint were able to easily spot Balionic gunboats with their advanced IR sensor embedded into their DAS systems. Theyd quickly neutralize these Balionic assets utilizing SDBs guided precisely by lasers and IR tracking. 

The PSDF seemed to already have achieved dominance in multiple domains of the battlefield, but there was still one issue that needed to be addressed. Balionic mines prevented the LCSG from continuing their advance unto Empire Island. To combat this, Yangyang-class Minesweepers were deployed in the vicinity of the LCSG to set off and destroy hostile mines using MDVs that mimicked the signals of a ship, acting as bait to force the mines to set off.[/i] [/spoiler][/quote]

[spoiler= Operation Guardian Angel
[sub]Massanikos at War[/sub]]

The Most Serene Republic of Massanikos is a seafaring nation, it has always been a seafaring nation. The mythology that Massanikan Children are taught tell the tale of how their ancestors fought desperately against sea monsters, raiders, and the Gods to make it to their islands. These stories contain larger than life figures such as Pleiades and Hector, the founders of the First Massanikan Colony. The students are taught that when you're at sea, there are very few people who can come and help you. You are on your own, if the worst is to come.

It is why they are so appalled to hear that the Dutch State would mercilessly attack the Civilian Merchant Shipping of the Republic of [nation]Pantagruel[/nation]. The public demands an answer for the lost lives of their allies, and the attempted gross violation of human dignity shown by the Dutch State. It is for this reason that [i][b]Operation Guardian Angel[/b][/i] has been declared by the Massanikan Ministry of Defense. The following troops will be sent to protect Daesunian Merchant Shipping, against all enemies. 

10 - 5th Generation Multirole Fighters
20 - 4th Generation Multirole Fighters
1 - AWACS Aircraft
1 - Maritime Patrol Aircraft
2 - Frigates
2 - Corvettes
2,000 - Massanikan Soldiers

These assets will be operating out of EDU aligned ports and airbases in [nation]Imerria[/nation]. The forces will be escorting Daesunian Merchant Shipping and patrolling the area hunting for pirates. They will spare no enemy who attacks a Daesunian Merchant Vessel. Even though the Massanikan Force is small, they are well trained and prepared to show off the full tactical level power that they have to wield. 

[/spoiler]
